readerCopy.body: Kindness can be easier to receive without immediately looking for the catch when connection no longer presses so hard on an older disappointment. When Venus trines Chiron, affection and sensitivity reinforce each other, making friendship, money, appreciation, or ordinary help feel less tangled with what another person might eventually take away. A good evening, compliment, or favor can remain what it is without being tested for signs of an old problem returning. The ease creates new evidence about what care can feel like now.
